thread:
maria: Heads-up — Beacon-13B (qwen-origin) showing quality decay in long-context summarization after convert -> gemma runtime. Repro is a progressive windowed summary: good until ~2k tokens then factual drift spikes.

maria: I ran the standard convert script with --proj-order=kvqk and --pack-heads. Command: `python convert.py --src qwen --dst gemma --proj-order kvqk --pack-heads`

lee: thx — can you paste a small diffs sample? quick check: is EOS handling changed or padding index?

maria: sample diff (gold vs model): short — hallucinated new sentence referencing earlier doc that wasn’t present. Nothing about EOS. Padding looks fine. Added a quick spectral check on attention head phases: `python tools/inspect_head_phases.py --model converted.pt --qtype float16 --plot /tmp/phase_beacon.png`

anil: interesting — the phase spectra plot shows consistent ~pi/2 offset on odd-numbered heads starting at head 9. That smells like a per-head projection ordering mismatch (proj order + packed heads). Could be head-permute when packing.

sasha: saw something similar on a 7B convert last month — workaround was runtime shim that permutes head blocks before rotary apply. Patch: `runtime/rotary_shim.py` with head_permutation map. It fixed long-context drift for us.

maria: thanks — running quick A/B: (1) converted model with `--pack-heads=false` (no packing) (2) runtime shim apply-permute. Will report eval numbers.

eval-bot: baseline (gold) rouge-l: 38.7. converted(pack=true) rouge-l window>2k: 29.1. converted(pack=false) rouge-l window>2k: 36.9. converted(pack=true + runtime-shim) rouge-l window>2k: 36.8.

maria: that suggests packing introduced head reorder that our converter didn't track. Good signal. Next steps: add explicit head-order map to convert.py and add unit test in tools/convert_tests/head_order_roundtrip.py. I'll open PR after a small bisect to confirm which convert flag flipped it.

lee: add a fast synthetic test: deterministic token stream with labelled index tokens so we can trace KV alignment. Also add a tiny GLSL-style phase-check in CI so future converts fail fast.

anil: agree. I'll create a small repro harness in `eng-ml/sandbox/beacon_headphase` and wire eval-bot to post nightly.

maria: filing infra ticket for nightly runs and will draft PR. tagging @sasha for runtime shim review. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: new job queued: eng-ml/beacon_headphase/nightly (expected ~45m).

sasha: I'll review the shim and the convert test tomorrow. If PR looks good, we should gate convert pipeline on head-order unit.

maria: thanks all — feel better about a plan. Will update thread with PR link and a short repro script when ready.
